UI_LC93_Console_AcKeys: Tab or Enter takes the picked suggestion, Up and Down move through them, Esc shuts them.
UI_LC93_Console_ChatAdmin: A chat line to the staff only.
UI_LC93_Console_ChatAll: A chat line to everyone on the server.
UI_LC93_Console_ChatFaction: A chat line to your faction.
UI_LC93_Console_ChatSafehouse: A chat line to your safehouse's members.
UI_LC93_Console_ChatSay: A chat line to those near you.
UI_LC93_Console_ChatWhisper: A chat line to one player.
UI_LC93_Console_ChatYell: A chat line heard further than say; zombies hear it too.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdCreateHorde2: Spawns zombies at a place with chosen traits (crawler, on fire, sitting and more); at most 500 at a time.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdDebugPlayer: Lets a player join and play in debug mode, or stops it.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdFilled: In the chat box, to send from there: %1
UI_LC93_Console_CmdHelpCmd: Lists the commands your role can use, or tells what one does.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdHelpSP: Single player: no server to send to. A pick opens the debug menu's own window, where there is one.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdHelpServer: A click fills the line with the example. Change the names, then Send.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdHelpUndo: This one can't be undone: Send asks first.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdList: Lists the animals the server and your game know of.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdLog: Sets how much one log category, or all of them, writes on the server.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdNoMatch: No command your role can use matches "%1".
UI_LC93_Console_CmdNotSent: Not sent: the game gave no way to send it.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdPickHint: Pick a command to fill the line
UI_LC93_Console_CmdReloadAllLua: Reloads every Lua file on the server.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdRemove: Removes the zombies, corpses, vehicles or animals nearby.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdRemoveAdmin: Takes admin away from a player.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdRemoveZombies: Removes the zombies round you or round a place.
UI_LC93_Console_CmdSearchHint: The search looks at the name, the syntax, what it does and the capability.
UI_LC93_Console_Coming: Coming in a later update. The log is on the first page of the strip.
UI_LC93_Console_Help: Enter runs the line. Up and Down step through the lines you ran.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpClear: Empty the list, as the game's clear command does
UI_LC93_Console_HelpExport: Write what the filters show to a new .log file in Zomboid/Lua
UI_LC93_Console_HelpFileExport: Each Export, named for the date and time.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpFilter: Tick to show these lines, untick to hide them. The counts follow the search.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpKeyEnter: Runs the line or the scratchpad; with suggestions open, takes the picked one.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpKeyEsc: Shuts the suggestions; again, lets go of the line.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpKeyF11: The game's Lua Debugger, where break on error lives.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpKeyShiftEnter: A new line in the scratchpad.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpKeyTab: Takes the picked suggestion (with none open, the game's own).
UI_LC93_Console_HelpKeyToggle: Opens and closes the console (the game's own key, Toggle Lua Console in its key options).
UI_LC93_Console_HelpKeyUpDown: Older and newer runs; with suggestions open, moves through them.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpNoLoad: The scratchpad can't run without loadstring. One line still can.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpPad: Enter runs the box, Shift+Enter makes a new line, Up on the first line steps back.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpPadA: Ticks a filter, opens an error, types on Project Zomboid's pad keyboard, takes a suggestion, presses a button.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpPadB: Shuts the suggestions or the band's question; otherwise closes the console.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpPadBumpers: Older and newer runs, on the line or the scratchpad.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpPadDpad: Moves between the page strip, the filters, the search, the log, the line and the band. Left from a page goes to the page strip.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpPadX: Exports the log; saves a snippet in the scratchpad; sends the line on Commands.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpPadY: Swaps the one line and the scratchpad.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpPage: Help: what runs where, the keys, the controller, the files.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpRow: Pick a line to copy it. An error opens to its whole stack; click it again to shut it.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpRun: Run the line as Lua, through the game's own console
UI_LC93_Console_HelpSave: Save the box as a snippet, kept in Zomboid/Lua/LuaConsole93_snippets.txt
UI_LC93_Console_HelpSnippet: Load it into the box. Right-click to rename it.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpToLine: Swap the box back for the one line
UI_LC93_Console_HelpToPad: Swap the line for a box of many lines, past 256 characters
UI_LC93_Console_HelpWhere1: The line and the scratchpad run Lua in your own game, where every mod's code runs, through the game's own console. On a server that is your client, not the server: it runs only for a role with the Lua console capability, or for the host.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpWhere2: The log is what the game's console box receives in debug mode (prints, warnings, the console's own lines) and the F11 Lua Debugger's error list, side by side. Lines the game writes only to console.txt do not reach it.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpWhere3: Server commands (the Commands page) run on the server, sent as chat sends them, and only the ones your role can use are listed. In single player there is no server: each points at the debug menu's own way of doing it.
UI_LC93_Console_HelpWhere4: Suggestions open by themselves: globals after two letters, a table's fields after a dot, an object's methods after a colon (Java methods marked Java).
UI_LC93_Console_HelpWhere5: The console is part of debug mode: start the game with -debug to have it.
UI_LC93_Console_NoLoad: No loadstring in this build of the game.
UI_LC93_Console_NoLoadBody: The scratchpad needs it to run more than one line (42.20.4 took it out once; 42.21 put it back). The one-line command still runs through the game's own console, up to 256 characters. Your snippets and history stay on disk.
UI_LC93_Console_NoMatch: Nothing in the log matches. The search looks at the message, the mod, the file and every line of an error's stack; some kinds, mods or files may be unticked on the left.
UI_LC93_Console_NotAllowed: This server does not let you run Lua
UI_LC93_Console_SpLog: The debuglog.cfg file, read as the game starts
UI_LC93_Console_SpLua: F11, the Lua Debugger: reload a file there
UI_LC93_Console_SpNoneLong: Nothing like it in single player: server commands need a server (host a game from the main menu to use them).
UI_LC93_Console_SpSave: The game saves as you quit
UI_LC93_Console_SpTeleport: The world map in debug mode: right-click, Teleport
UI_LC93_Console_SpVehicle: Right-click the world in debug mode: the vehicle spawn
UI_LC93_Console_SpZombies: Right-click the world in debug mode: the zombie tools
UI_LC93_WinMenu_Help: Window menu: theme, accent, text size, see-through, controller highlight and reset.
UI_LC93_Win_HelpPin: Pin this window open. Unpinned, it rolls up to its title bar when the pointer leaves it.
UI_LC93_Win_HelpUnpin: Unpin: the window rolls up to its title bar when the pointer leaves it, and down when the pointer is over its title bar.
UI_LC93_Window_ResizeHelp: Drag to change the window's size.
